videos.title: Ryan and Yummy visiting Grandma’s House!😱 | Slow English Listening Story (A2 Level)
videos.description:
Ryan and Yummy visiting Grandma’s House!😱 | Slow English Listening Story (A2 Level) https://youtu.be/QCQGpDDQhkU

Welcome to Amelia Daily English — learn English with funny everyday stories from Amelia and her family. 😄

Learn English the easy and fun way with slow, clear storytelling.
Our videos are made for A2 learners who want to improve listening, speaking, and confidence through simple, real-life family stories.
Enjoy natural English, easy vocabulary, and engaging situations that help you understand and speak better every day.

In today’s video, the family takes a simple trip to grandma’s house… but everything feels a little different.
The road is quiet, the air is fresh, and the countryside is full of peaceful and beautiful scenes.

Along the way, Ethan and Noah discover many new and interesting things — green fields, small animals, and simple village life. Some moments are funny, some are a bit surprising, and some are calm and relaxing.

At grandma’s house, they enjoy warm family time, simple food, and happy conversations. It’s a day full of small moments that feel special in a quiet and gentle way.

This story uses slow and clear English, making it perfect for A2 learners to practice listening, understand daily vocabulary, and enjoy natural conversations.
